name: Incentive Premium
definition: Cash premium made available if the securities holder consents or participates to an event.

PerSecurity.name: Per Security
PerSecurity.definition: Number of securities giving right to a premium.

PerVote.name: Per Vote
PerVote.definition: Number of votes giving right to a premium.

PerAttendee.name: Per Attendee
PerAttendee.definition: Indicates that the premium is given per attendee.

PremiumAmount.name: Premium Amount
PremiumAmount.definition: Cash premium paid per security, per vote or per attendee.

PaymentDate.name: Payment Date
PaymentDate.definition: Date/time for the payment of the premium.

Meeting.name: Meeting
Meeting.definition: Meeting for which an incentive premium is specified.

CorporateActionDistribution.name: Corporate Action Distribution
CorporateActionDistribution.definition: CorporateActionDistribution for which an incentive premium is specified.
